 Forecast 
 High temperatures returning into the 50s for the first time since last Wednesday as central New York will see a beautiful next couple of days! 
 High and low temperatures 
 A dominant high-pressure ridge is going to shape our weather pattern through Saturday before an incoming cold front brings a return of rain chances Sunday. 
 The big picture 
 Temperatures ranging 10-15 degrees above average this week with overnight lows staying above freezing in Syracuse. Make sure to enjoy the sunshine!
